craft_notes: Sthāyin: sa-aham crown (#2 with v97: the second identity-claim: not He-I but 'he indeed I' — and the 'from firmness' condition: belief as ACT). Sanskrit: sarvajñaḥ...evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyāc chivo bhavet → L4 keeps epithet-then-claim-then-mechanism. Rows: row 2 (he-indeed-I→from-firmness). Close: Śiva (bhavet — becomes: the claim's verb is BECOME, made real by firmness). Rejected: 'I am God' proselytizing — killed: he-indeed-I kept (the iti-quoting structure); dropping 'from firmness' — killed: dārdhya is HOW it becomes true (conviction, not decree).

lines: he indeed I — Śiva-natured, from firmness Śiva.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sa evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyāc chivo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Who am I? → From firm conviction, 'he indeed I': Śiva-natured one becomes Śiva.
c1_essence: All-knowing, all-doing: he indeed I — Śiva from firmness.
